person.text: Research Associate, Antibody Development at Antibodies Incorporated (per Streak/LinkedIn). Describes personal side projects on **antibody and drug optimization using protein language models and folding prediction models**. Education and prior roles: to be confirmed.

company.text: Founded in **1962** by Jim and Carol Hillman in **Davis, California**, where it still manufactures. Started with secondary antibodies, then radioimmunoassays, latex/strep tests and ELISA. Today sells monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies, kits and reagents worldwide, and offers custom antibody development, ADCC/CDC services, adenovirus production, contract manufacturing and ELISA services. Exhibits at neuroscience and gene-therapy meetings (SfN, ASGCT).

financials.text: Private company; revenue, headcount and ownership **not disclosed** — to be confirmed. Reagent business; no therapeutic pipeline, so budget for in-silico therapeutic design is unlikely.
